title: The Skysworn Standing Discipline
summary: The school discipline of the cultivation-side order on standing unshaken in the line and lending the line its calm.

title: Manual of the Azure Resolve Rite
summary: The school manual of a resolute rite in which valour is taught as a clear habit and closed with the rite itself.

title: The Sapphire Heart Course
summary: The school course of a poised sapphire heart that stays clear under any weight and shares its clearness with the line.

title: The Zenith Heart Discipline
summary: The school's high discipline of an exalted heart raised to a bright still height with the formed Core behind every act of will.

title: The Gale Heart Discipline
summary: The school discipline of a tenacious heart that bends to the gale and does not break and that carries comrades through it.

title: Manual of the Wind-Bound Heart
summary: The school manual of an undaunted heart bound to the wind by oath that goes where the wind goes and does not turn.

title: The Storm Heart Reckoning
summary: The school reckoning of an indomitable heart tempered in storms that mends its own and calls its fallen back to the line.

title: The Tempest Sovereign Discipline
summary: The school's deepest discipline of an unconquered heart whose tempest rises with the pressure laid on it and answers in one final stroke.
